items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels will not be placed on IR after elbow dislocation imaging and specialist consults; consensus is week-to-week with team and player aiming for ASAP return. Ruled out only for this weekend vs Seahawks.
items.why: Imaging evaluated, multiple specialists, no surgery/IR planned
items.implication: Mariota starts short-term; McLaurin retains some value per target share history with Mariota
items.opportunity: Monitor return timeline; no 4-game IR minimum

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua DNP second straight day (hip); McVay: not making great progress, unsure for Week 3 vs DEN, not long-term but cautious.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness, limited progress per McVay
items.implication: High chance miss another game; Adams elevated target share
items.opportunity: Davante Adams 42% tgt rate on 142 routes sans Nacua

items.text: Texans WR Nico Collins DNP second straight day (hamstring); sources expect miss Week 3 vs IND, very much in doubt.
items.why: Grade 1 hamstring, no practice this week
items.implication: Schultz elevated; TE1 upside vs Colts TE-friendly D
items.opportunity: Schultz 30% routes/28% share last week sans Collins

items.text: Jaxson Dart knee surgery today (meniscus + MCL repair); out for regular season per coach.
items.implication: Giants QB situation long-term hit; Nabers etc impacted

items.text: After Rhamondre Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game. Gap narrowed but still ranks Stevenson ahead Week 3.
items.implication: Henderson rising but not full takeover yet
items.opportunity: Pass pro still limits; monitor committee

items.text: Drake London 12 career games with Michael Penix: >20 PPR pts, 35% tgt share, 97 rec yds/game avg.
Davante Adams 142 routes without Puka Nacua as Ram, targeted 60 (42%). Results: 5-35-3 vs JAX 2025; 8-195-2 vs NYG Monday.
items.implication: Adams WR1 upside if Nacua out again

items.text: Jonathon Brooks expected IR (only 5 games across 3 seasons); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup (Etienne also IR).
Loves Dalton Schultz @ IND: team-high 28% target share last week with Nico Collins out; Indy allowed 4th-most yards to TEs.
Zay Flowers (hamstring) not practicing; first hurt Aug 20 joint practice, aggravated Week 1 after 5-150-1 half, no full practice since; Ravens to Brazil.
items.why: Lingering hamstring from camp/Week1, travel factor

items.text: Hurt WR/TE/QB: Puka Nacua, Nico Collins, Brock Bowers, AJ Brown, Zay Flowers, Jayden Daniels, Caleb Williams, Jaxson Dart, Jayden Reed, others. RBs meh committees: Brooks, Dowdle, Mason.
Loves Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest RB rush yards prop 88.5; Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite prop + weak run D matchup

items.text: Loves Chris Olave vs LV: double-digit tgts both games, 14.8 aDOT, 53% air yards; LV allows league-high 18.7 ypr to WRs.
Loves Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% tgt share both games, RB7 util score 86; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
